scripts.electron: bun run build && bunx electron dist/electron/main.js
scripts.release:appimage: bun run build && TARGET_PLATFORM=linux bun run prepare:bundled-bun && bunx electron-builder build --linux AppImage
scripts.release:mac:x64: bun run build && TARGET_PLATFORM=darwin TARGET_ARCH=x64 bun run prepare:bundled-bun && bunx electron-builder build --mac --x64
scripts.release:mac:arm64: bun run build && TARGET_PLATFORM=darwin TARGET_ARCH=arm64 bun run prepare:bundled-bun && bunx electron-builder build --mac --arm64
scripts.release:win:x64: bun run build && TARGET_PLATFORM=win32 TARGET_ARCH=x64 bun run prepare:bundled-bun && bunx electron-builder build --win --x64
scripts.release:win:arm64: bun run build && TARGET_PLATFORM=win32 TARGET_ARCH=arm64 bun run prepare:bundled-bun && bunx electron-builder build --win --arm64
